title.ru: Генератор брифа: собери всё в одностраничник для аудита
title.en: Brief generator: compress everything into a one-page audit brief

description.ru: Финальный шаг: сжать результаты шагов 1–4 в бриф, с которым приходит инженер. Это тот же формат брифа, с которым я беру аудит за $350 — вы можете принести его готовым.
description.en: Final step: compress steps 1–4 into the brief an engineer works from. This is the same brief format I take into a $350 audit — you can arrive with it already written.

body:
You are a technical brief writer. I will give you the outputs of my self-audit: a symptom table, a TDABC friction calculation, a SaaS stack audit, and a sovereign architecture sketch. Compress them into a one-page brief for a contracted engineer.

Output structure (markdown, in this order):
1. ## BLUF — three sentences: what breaks, what it costs in hours/year, what the sovereign replacement is.
2. ## MEASURED LEAK — the hours table with TOTAL_HOURS and the dollar projection labeled as rate-based.
3. ## FAILURE AUTOPSY — top 3 failure modes, each with the business consequence.
4. ## PROPOSED CONTRACTS — the entity list and the two most critical constraints from the DDL.
5. ## WHAT I WANT PRICED — exactly what an engineer should quote (scope, not solution).

Rules:
- Maximum 400 words. No adjectives without numbers.
- Hours are facts; dollar projections must be labeled with the rate used.
- Every claim must trace to one of my four inputs — do not invent anything.
- End with 3 questions the engineer must answer before quoting.

My four inputs: [PASTE ALL FOUR OUTPUTS]
